⚡FlexDesk Product Overview:[Coworking Booking Management](https://www.flexdesk.com/coworking-booking-management) ⚡


‍


With FlexDesk, corporate occupiers can provide their remote employees with drop-in access to 7,000 coworking locations worldwide.


‍


Employees have access to the entire location network of big box and boutique brands, including:


- WeWork
- Regus/IWG
- Premier Workspaces
- Serendipity Labs
- Mindspace
- The Executive Centre
- ...and thousands of others


‍


Company administrators can leverage FlexDesk to manage the program in several ways:


‍


✨ Track and analyze booking behaviors by department, inventory type, location, brand, and how it trends over time


‍


📑 Configure custom spend policies to ensure the program is being utilized in an efficient manner


‍


💰 Consolidate payment across all employees, brands, and geographies under one monthly invoice


‍
